agent_id.description: the agent's id: entity `entity:<id>` in its affinity, actor `agent:<id>`

aieos.description: the agent's AIeOS 1.1.0 document; empty = no identity boot

start_memories.description: `{what, with?, at?}` written once as episodes

disclose.description: the field paths of the agent's record its own brain may see

own_tools.description: the agent's own tool names: a client tool of the same name is dropped

round_idle_ms.description: the round watchdog's wait; keep it equal to the collector's

tools_allow.description: the tool scope of every turn (an allow list also filters client tools)

tools_deny.description: tools removed from every turn's scope

now_utc.description: an ISO instant the watchdog reads instead of the wall clock (tests)
